t: You're at Manor House tube station on the Piccadilly line, between Finsbury Park and Turnpike Lane. It sits on the boundary of fare zones 2 and 3, and it straddles the border between Hackney and Haringey. Three entrances and the postal address are in Hackney, and one entrance is in Haringey. The station was designed by Charles Holden, an English architect best known for designing many London Underground stations in the 1920s and 1930s, and for the Underground's headquarters at 55 Broadway.
